summary: Reproduced the generic-template failure caused by unconditional structured tool_reference conversion, then applied and verified the issue-specific upstream candidate. Generic templates now receive a text marker and only referenced deferred tools, while templates with native deferred-reference support retain structured references and the complete deferred catalog.

tests.what_was_measured: Before the fix, conversion emitted a structured tool_reference part and a strict generic Jinja renderer raised 'Unexpected item type in content.' Exit 17 was the reproduction script's expected failure sentinel.
74 tests and 5 subtests passed, covering capability detection, strict generic/Qwen-style rendering, discovery gating, forced-tool choices, content boundaries, and the native GLM path.
